name: Pantore Pay
long_description: Pantore Pay is the solution for restaurants cash flow issues and allows restaurants to shop for supplies and pay any other bills using Pantore's credit line.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
I’ve built companies, shut them down, and started over more times than I’d like to admit.

I built a ridesharing app in Brazil before Uber got there. Then a mental health platform that helped change national policy on online therapy. Then Pantore Pay (W22), where we gave working capital to micro-businesses that banks wouldn’t touch. founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Fascinated by technology since childhood, I had the opportunity to work at 99/Didi in the pre- Unicorn operations area. Soon after, I was part of the Kovi (YC W19) founding team and responsible for all the operations, supply and maintenance. In 2020, I created 42Move, a moving startup company to help people when moving home. Between 2021 and 2023, we created Pantore, a group buying and reverse option to save up to 30% of restaurants buyings. In October 2023 I decided to focus in IA new business.
